description: Complete and wire the production Customer create/modify/query adapters, make the in-memory host support the existing unit-of-work path, seed the Document Number Control test scheme, and correct the stale default-bank expectation.
steps: Add EF-compatible Customer aggregate factory/update methods and a production CustomerAggregateMapper that maps approved request data, children, identity normalization, safe audit snapshots, and create/modify responses without persisted master display names.

Add a CustomerCodeGenerator adapter over INumberingSchemeRepository.IssueNextAsync and NumberFormatter for global CUSTOMER issuance; seed an idempotent English-only CUST{SEQ:8} scheme in SystemAdminAppFactory for the integration host.

Change ICustomerProjectionMapper and QueryCustomerHandler to asynchronous cancellation-aware projection, and add CustomerProjectionMapper that resolves current active Lookup, Nationality, and Company-scoped GL names from repositories at query time.

Register the Customer code generator, aggregate mapper, and projection mapper in Finnova.SystemAdminService/Program.cs; configure EF Core InMemory transaction warnings in SystemAdminAppFactory while leaving SQL Server transaction behavior unchanged.

Change Failed_child_validation_rolls_back_customer_and_audit in CustomerOnboardingApiTests to expect HttpStatusCode.Conflict for ERR-CUSTOMER-DEFAULT-BANK while retaining the atomic no-write assertions.
acceptance_criteria: CustomerOnboardingApiTests reaches production Customer handlers instead of failing at DI activation.
Create returns a unique 12-character alphanumeric CustomerCode, modify preserves that code, query returns the modified customer, and two audit rows exist.
Query resolves the renamed Lookup value at read time and Customer has no GroupName persistence property.
Unknown/inactive Lookup, Nationality, GL, and mandatory Document references return their existing Customer error codes without writes.
The failed default-bank request returns 409 ERR-CUSTOMER-DEFAULT-BANK and leaves Customer and audit counts unchanged.
The unknown modify request returns 404 ERR-CUSTOMER-404 without echoing the unknown code.
findings: The targeted class uses CustomerOnboardingAppFactory, which already replaces only the external address boundary. Do not replace production Customer mappers with test doubles. The existing middleware maps default-bank invariant failures to 409, so the test expectation is outdated.
